room.organization: A north-east daylight dining group uses a mixed bench-and-chair arrangement, while the south-west entry court and south-wall service route remain open.
room.main_path: From door_00 on the west wall, walk east across the open south-west court, approach the table at its south end, and branch north to the two west-side chairs or east toward window_00.
room.protected_open_space: The south-west landing, table south approach, and a continuous strip between the table and cabinet_01 remain free for serving and turning.

furniture.placement_rationale: table_01 is offset into the north-east half so window_00 provides side daylight without the table touching the east clearance band. Its south edge faces the open door_00 approach, while the north and west edges support the mixed bench and chair seating rather than a symmetric ring.

bench_01 runs along the north side of table_01, using the long edge efficiently for a family seat while leaving the east window_00 side open. Its local -Y front faces table_01 with a deliberate 0.17 m knee and sit-down gap, and its shallow depth leaves a standing strip behind it near the north wall.

chair_01 occupies the lower west side of table_01, facing east toward the near place setting. Its west pull-out space opens toward the clear door_00 landing, and its position avoids the south-end serving path.

chair_02 shares the west edge of table_01 with chair_01 but is separated along the table length for two distinct places. The same east-facing yaw serves its setting, while its north-west pull-out strip remains clear of bench_01.

chair_03 is the loose south-end seat of table_01, facing north toward the tabletop and leaving the west side open for entry from door_00. Its centered end position provides a guest place without enclosing the table or blocking cabinet_01 access.

cabinet_01 anchors the south wall as serving and dish storage, close to table_01 but outside chair_03's front and pull-out zone. Its north-facing front is approached from the open south-west route, and it stays well west of window_00 so the glazing remains visually and physically open.
